title: 1910 Frank Hagerman built the three story cement block building end of the bridge ramp
description: Frank Hagerman arrived in the village that would later become Hartland. He operated a ferry across the river using a set pole and worked for Rev. Benjamin Jewett at the Becaguimic grist mill. Together with his son in 1910, Frank constructed a three-storey concrete block building with a full basement, located across from the bridge ramp. Tenants lived above the retail space, which was elevated above street level and accessible by stairs. Hagerman became well known for his thousands of catchy slogans, most famously, “B 4 U buy C Frank.” A skilled salesman, he sold machinery, soap, and brush products, and also owned a grist mill.
